summary: Master advanced Property and Real Estate Development with DCF modeling, RICS standards, and FIDIC risk management. Enroll in this 5-day expert course today.
lede: Property development training helps senior professionals assess project feasibility and manage development from site selection through asset operations. Participants practice building multi-phase discounted cash flow models, comparing debt and equity financing, and setting measurable sustainability targets, while assessing contract risks and preparing property management plans.
audienceIntro: This advanced course is designed for senior professionals who manage complex development lifecycles, oversee investment portfolios, or lead strategic asset optimization initiatives.
modules: Market Cycle Analysis and Site Selection
Advanced Financial Modeling and DCF Construction
Capital Stack Optimization and Financing Structures
Regulatory Navigation and Contract Risk Management
Operational Asset Management and ISO Standards
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of financial principles (NPV, IRR, Cap Rate) and be proficient in Microsoft Excel for financial modeling. Experience in property management, construction, finance, or urban planning is recommended but not strictly required. This course is advanced-level; prior exposure to basic real estate development concepts is expected.
